newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Henderson China expands China investment.
newsitem.headline: Henderson China expands China investment.

text.p: Henderson China Holdings Ltd will consider participating in Chinese government-sponsored home-ownership development projects and to expand investments in major cities in China, the company said in its annual report.
Henderson China will invest 2.5 billion yuan in a Chinese government-sponsored home-ownership development project in Tianjin, said managing director Peter Lee on Tuesday.

Speaking after Henderson China's annual general meeting, Lee said the company would invest in a residential development, Fortune Park, in the Futian district in Shenzhen, across the border from Hong Kong.
Lee said the Fortune Park development was expected to contribute gross floor area of eight million square feet. Residential units at the site are due to go on sale in the next year or two.
Henderson China, a China property arm of Henderson Land Development Co Ltd, owns 23 development sites with a total attributable floor area of 28 million sq. ft., the annual report said.

Four residential, office and retail developments are currently under pre-sale in China, the company said in its annual report. The developments are in Beijing, Shanghai and Panyu in Guangdong province, it said.
Henderson China said most of its land bank portfolio in China is concentrated in Beijing, Shanghai and Guangzhou, where sites were bought at relatively low costs.
Lee said the company would also consider investments in other infrastructure projects, such as toll roads in China's major cities.
